# Model specification: gpio-exti 1.0.0

GPIO ports, the external interrupt controller (EXTI) and its port-to-line selection (SYSCFG), as used for chip selects, data-ready lines, LEDs and buttons.

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | GPIO levels. |
| exti | Edge-triggered external interrupts with port selection. |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| pin_mode | control | base | Per pin input, output, alternate function or analog. |
| output_level | control | base | Per pin driven level in output mode. |
| set_reset | control | base | Atomic set/reset of output levels (write-only). |
| input_level | status | base | Per pin level read back: driven level for outputs, external level (from a chip model or a host input) for inputs. |
| pin_config | control | base | Speed, pull, open-drain, alternate function number: stored only. |
| line_source | control | exti | Per EXTI line 0-15: which port's pin of that number feeds it (SYSCFG). |
| rising_trigger | control | exti | Per line: a rising edge sets pending. |
| falling_trigger | control | exti | Per line: a falling edge sets pending. |
| line_irq_enable | control | exti | Per line: pending raises the line's interrupt. |
| software_trigger | control | exti | Per line: sets pending by software. |
| pending | status | exti | Per line: an edge or software trigger occurred. |
| pending_ack | ack | exti | Write 1 to clear pending. |
| line_irq | event | exti | Interrupt of the line or line group (EXTI0..4, EXTI9_5, EXTI15_10; Devicetree interrupts). |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-GPIO-B001 | base | A pin in output mode drives output_level; set_reset changes only the pins it names, set winning over reset for the same pin; input_level of an output pin reads the driven level. |
| ADV-GPIO-B002 | base | A pin in input mode reads the level given by the connected model (chip interrupt line, cs-gpios consumer) or host input; unconnected inputs read their reset level. |
| ADV-GPIO-B003 | base | A change of a pin's level is delivered to the models connected to that pin (chip select to the SPI child, ADV-GPIO-002) at the clock of the write. |
| ADV-GPIO-B004 | exti | An edge on pin n of the port selected by line_source for line n sets pending of line n when the matching trigger is enabled (ADV-GPIO-001); edges on other ports' pin n do not. |
| ADV-GPIO-B005 | exti | line_irq is raised while pending and line_irq_enable for any line of its group; pending_ack clears pending. |
| ADV-GPIO-B006 | exti | software_trigger sets pending as an edge would. |

**Timing.** Level changes and edges take effect at the clock of the write or of the model's event.

**Out of scope.** event (non-interrupt) mode, wake-up and low-power domains, configurable lines above 15 other than as stored, pin locking (stored only), analog behaviour
